# Benedict documentation — reading order

Prefer these pages for current behavior. Do not treat Historical pages as the current API.

2. docs/install.md — clone, uv, .env, make run
3. docs/SLACK_SETUP.md — Slack app tokens
4. docs/MCP.md — Cursor / Claude Code
5. docs/commands.md — onboard, ask, status, index, architect
6. docs/PROGRESS.md — unattended progress loop
7. docs/OPERATOR_UI_DESIGN.md — localhost request debugger
8. docs/REQUEST_PATH.md — behavior source of truth
9. docs/CODE_MAP.md — files, protocols, composition root
10. docs/configuration.md — environment variables
11. docs/troubleshooting.md
12. docs/adr/0001-local-operator-ui.md
13. docs/adr/0002-progress-loop.md
14. docs/PROCESS.md — how to add a doc
